scope: Native request-cache staging/publication plus source adaptation; whole Goose compiler integration pending root batch
qualified_native_laws: failed child discards only candidate COW queue and memfds
payload and paths are owned copies
all three artifact writes and removals publish after adoption
replaced queue entry closes old memfd
exclusive lock contention retries then joined publication finishes
optional filesystem failure drains and later staging/publishing succeeds
OS path/component limits and embedded NUL declined without truncation

bounds.path: Linux PATH_MAX and NAME_MAX; no truncation

publication_contract: Register blot_request_cache_publish as native post-adoption hook; supervisor waits QUIESCENT before protocol acceptance or joined close shutdown. Publisher performs fixed-storage syscall work, never Goose callbacks, and drains on optional failures.
rollback_contract: Encoding and sealed-memfd staging happen before adoption. Rejected candidate exit drops only its COW queue; every adopted publication drains before the next request fork, leaving baseline queue empty.
request_source_contract: persist/persistJoined bypass detached writers and file locks; publish/remove stage owned native records; save stages checkpoint; report-file mutations are omitted during requests. Ordinary nontransactional CLI persistence remains unchanged.
limitations: one cache key with three parts per request; another key safely declines optional staging
per-syscall kernel filesystem I/O scheduling is not bounded by the userspace retry deadline
optional post-adopt write failure does not revoke accepted heap/reply
cache report file is not updated for transactional requests
